job.title: Community Manager
job.description:
Community Manager – PC/Console Studio – Hertfordshire

Amiqus have partnered with an exciting studio based in Hertfordshire who are looking to hire a Community Manager to join their growing team. The studio has helped release some of the best indie games on the Console/PC market and this position will offer you the chance to work with these titles and new releases.

As the Community Manager you will be tasked on growing the Community for a range of new titles, which will appeal to a wide range of gamers. You will ideally be a gamer yourself and you will be responsible for engaging with the online community across all areas of social media such as forums, Facebook, Twitter/X, Reddit, Discord and TikTok etc. There will also be a creative element to the role where you will create new and engaging content, while maintaining and moderating forums.

The role will offer you a fast-paced environment in a fast-growing studio with games that have attracted a large number of players. You will also be involved with the product launch of new upcoming titles and taking studios through the journey of first contact to a shipped release. You’ll also get the opportunity to attend worldwide events and liaise with their existing Marketing Team to uphold a positive brand and PR for the studio.

The studio offer a range of benefits such as relocation assistance, pension, choice of laptop, a generous holiday allowance and free parking.

This role offers a hybrid model which is onsite 3 days a week, with 2 days working remotely.

We are unable to offer fully remote working options currently or sponsor visas.

Salary range - £30,000-£45,000

Requirements
  • At least 2 years’ experience in the games industry as a Community/Social Media Manager
  • Experience of growing Communities through various methods of social media
  • Enthusiastic about gaming on all platforms
  • Ability to interface with clients, consumers and media
  • Highly approachable and a good ability to network
  • An avid player of indie games
  • Good vocabulary with a high level of written English
This is a fantastic opportunity to work with a studio who are dominating the games market and can offer the successful candidate a position of influence in the business to manage an autonomous desk.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please send your CV to will.hudson@amiqus.com

job.title: Unity Developer
job.description:
Unity Developer (3 Month FTC) – New PC Title – 100% Remote working (From the UK)

Salary range - £45,000-£70,000

A UK based Games studio are currently looking for a Unity Developer to work on a new innovative PC title, which they’re aiming to dominate its genre. Founded by established industry experts, the team are made up of developers who have a history of releasing a range of high-quality games, some of which have been adored in the games industry and have won a range of prestigious games awards. 

As the Unity Developer, you will work on the studios upcoming project, helping develop the gameplay and UI for this title. As a member of the core team, you will collaborate with other client programmers, designers and artists to assist on making world class experiences and levels.

The game will have a blend of adventure, puzzles with a deep story telling nature, so part of your role must ensure that the gameplay and UI work smoothly and lag free. This role can offer a chance to own quite a large area of the code side and would suit someone who enjoys working in a small team.

In return the studio can offer fully remote working from anywhere in the UK and an exciting project to work on, with a rare 4 day working week and a zero-crunch policy.

This is a 3-month FTC with the possibility of turning into a permanent contract. You must be already based in and eligible to work in the UK to apply for this role.

Requirements
  • Experience as a Unity Developer with a range of commercial games shipped  
  • Experience with PC/Console or Mobile games  
  • Multidiscipline experience of Programming – Gameplay being the most important!
  • An appreciation for Games Design
  • A portfolio demonstrating your experience would be a bonus!
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a studio who are working on a new title, which you will have a hand in from start to finish. To apply please send your CV to will.hudson@amiqus.com

job.title: Lead UI UX Designer
job.description:
Stockholm, Sweden | Hybrid (3 days onsite per week)

We're seeking an individual who can help our client to push boundaries, lead by example, and champion exceptional player experiences.

As a Lead UX Designer, you'll play a key role in defining and driving the user experience vision across their unannounced project.

This is a hands-on leadership position where you'll be expected to influence the direction of UX within the studio while remaining actively involved in the design, prototyping, and implementation of intuitive, engaging user experiences.

What we can tell you about the game is it's a AAA PvE and PVP FPS for console. Although production is in process, there's huge amount of creative input still needed. 

What you will do

  • Define and drive the UX vision, strategy, and best practices across multiple projects.
  • Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs that support engaging player experiences.
  • Partner closely with design, engineering, and art teams to ensure UX solutions are practical, scalable, and aligned with project goals.
  • Advocate for user-centred design and use player feedback, data, and research to inform decision-making.
  • Establish and evolve UX processes, workflows, and design systems to improve consistency and quality.
  • Mentor and support other designers, providing feedback and guidance to help raise the overall design standard.

Who you are

  • An experienced UI/UX Designer with proven leadership experience in games
  • Comfortable defining UX direction and influencing product decisions while remaining hands-on with design execution.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing user-centred design thinking, interaction design, and visual design expertise.
  • Experienced with wireframing, prototyping, user research, and usability testing methodologies.

What's on offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Relocation package and VISA support if required
  • Opportunity to shape the future of UX within a growing and ambitious studio.
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • Stockholm-based role with a hybrid working model, requiring onsite attendance three days per week.
Contact Alan Dixon on alan.dixon@amiqus.com for more details

job.title: Performance Marketing Manager
job.description:
Amiqus are currently working with a UK-based mobile games development studio to help them find a Performance Marketing Manager to join their team.

This role will be focusing on user acquisition for their successful free-to-play sports mobile game.

This role is all about execution, precision, and focus. You will be a crucial pillar of the Marketing team, taking the lead on the precise setup of campaigns and the daily management of creative assets.

If you have a perfectionist mindset, a sharp eye for the finer details of ad setup, and a hunger to gain hands-on experience in the fast-paced mobile gaming industry, this is the perfect stage for you.  

Requirements:
  • Interest in games and sports
  • Experience building and executing campaigns across Google, Meta, and TikTok
  • Ability to generate baseline performance reports and creative analysis
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • A collaborative individual who will thrive in a inclusive and supportive environment

This is a hybrid role, requiring one day per week onsite in their London office. The studio is offering up-to £45k annual salary depending on the individual.

If you’re interested in this role and want to find out more, please apply now! You can also reach out via email to chris.molleson@amiqus.com.

job.title: Experienced Producer (AAA Game Dev)
job.description:
Experienced Producer (AAA Game Dev) – based in the UK

This is a fantastic opportunity to be a part of one of the UK’s most successful and ambitious indie game developers. They are a team globally renowned and respected for their technical achievements within the industry and are embarking on their most recently announced and hugely ambitious project.

As a Producer you will play a key role in ensuring the quality of the studios releases, keeping the team up to date with current and future development plans and making sure the team has everything they need throughout. This is a very hands-on role and we are looking for someone who will enjoy the opportunity to take on all areas of production, from coordinating and tracking development tasks, supporting QA and managing bug lists. You’ll have familiarity with all phases of game development, bringing builds together and going through the various submission pipelines for all major platforms. You will wear multiple hats, getting stuck in wherever needed, be self-directed, and importantly, relish working closely with all disciplines.

Responsibilities
  • Help maintain a positive team culture and morale
  • Report on development progress and potential risks, proactively solving issues as they arise
  • Prioritise, delegate and help balance workloads for the team during development
  • Support with scheduling and defining deadlines
  • Ensure and facilitate clear communication amongst the team
  • Continuously seek opportunities to improve development effectiveness and quality of life
  • Ensure high quality releases

Qualifications & Experience
  • Experience in all stages of game development having worked on a project end to end as a Producer and shipped two games launched on multiple platforms.
  • Experience of supporting multiple projects on multiple platforms
  • Comfortable with basic scripting and able to read through debug output
  • Post-launch experience with a live service game is a plus
  • Self-driven and motivated with excellent organisational skills
  • Good analysis skills with an understanding of the difficulties involved in making a game, resulting in a logical approach to problem solving
  • Attention to detail
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to use your own initiative and work with minimal supervision
  • Good empathy and effectiveness at fostering a collaborative working environment
If the above sounds like it could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for then get in touch. For a casual chat about the role in more detail call me on 01925 839 722 or drop me an email on lee.burns@amiqus.com
